faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Get your main questions answered before requesting a quote.
faq.1.q: How long until my site is ready to go live?
faq.1.a: The average delivery time is 7 to 10 business days after you send your company information (logo, photos and contact details). Because we work with an optimized base structure, we guarantee fast delivery without compromising visual and technical quality.
faq.2.q: Will I be able to change texts and photos myself once the site is done?
faq.2.a: Yes, very easily. We build with the native WordPress editor (Gutenberg), with no dependence on complex systems. We also provide short video tutorials showing step by step how you or your team can update content in under 2 minutes.
faq.3.q: Why is your website faster than the competition?
faq.3.a: We build our sites with clean code and without piling on heavy plugins that slow the page down. A fast site loads instantly on your customer's phone (even on 4G), improves your Google ranking and keeps you from losing potential sales to slow loading.
faq.4.q: Are hosting and the domain already included in the price?
faq.4.a: Buying the domain (the .com.br address) and contracting hosting are done directly under your own CPF or CNPJ (Brazilian tax ID), so you are the sole owner of your data. We guide you through the whole process (which costs only a few reais per month) and handle the full technical setup at no extra cost.
